note: The fuzzer enables espeakSSML, causing ReadClause to parse the tag.
The leading '<' enters the SSML tag branch.

code: terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, xmlbase, &audio_text, voice_change, &base_voice, base_voice_variant_name, &ignore_text, &clear_skipping_text, &sayas_mode, &sayas_start, ssml_stack, &n_ssml_stack, &n_param_stack, (int *)speech_parameters);
note: ReadClause passes the parsed tag body and attributes to ProcessSsmlTag.
The tag name break maps to SSML_BREAK.
The strength attribute is present and points to the supplied value invalid.
The value invalid is not in mnem_break, so attrlookup returns the table default -1 without validation.
The negative value is used as an index into local stack array break_value, producing a stack-buffer-overflow read.
